# Setup

MCP setup

The MCP (Model Context Protocol) connects SE Ranking and Planable to AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT, so you can pull real data and draft work with plain-language prompts — no coding required. This page gets you connected; the [Use cases](https://help.seranking.com/hc/en-us/articles/29433578294684-Use-cases), [Skills library](https://help.seranking.com/hc/en-us/articles/29485358470300-Skills-library), and [Prompt Library](https://help.seranking.com/hc/en-us/articles/22903914755100-Prompt-library) sections show you what to do next.

## What is MCP?

The **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** is an open standard that connects an app's data to AI assistants. With the SE Ranking and Planable MCP servers connected, you can talk to your SEO and social data in natural language — inside tools like Claude Desktop, the ChatGPT connector, Gemini CLI, and others.

SE Ranking

## Connect SE Ranking MCP

The SE Ranking MCP server is available directly in the connector directories of Claude and ChatGPT, and can be added to other assistants via a custom connection.

- **Claude:** in **Settings → Connectors**, add the official SE Ranking connector from the directory and click **Connect** to authorize.
- **ChatGPT:** go to **Apps → Search apps → SE Ranking → Connect**, or open the [SE Ranking plugin in ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/apps/se-ranking/asdk_app_6a0b262d5c0c8191953dd94ba05412e2).
- **Custom connector (any MCP client):** add a custom connector with the URL https://api.seranking.com/mcp, name it **SE Ranking**, and authorize with OAuth or your API key.

Pick the connection method that fits your setup and follow the step-by-step tutorial below.

Verify it works

In your assistant, run a simple prompt such as *"Show me the organic search stats for example.com in the US."* A data-backed answer confirms the connection is live.

Planable

## Connect Planable MCP

The Planable MCP connects your social workspace to your AI assistant so you can draft and schedule posts by prompt. Setup lives in Planable's own Help Center:

- **Claude:** in **Settings → Connectors**, add the official Planable connector and click **Connect** to authorize.
- **ChatGPT:** open **Apps**, search for **Planable**, and connect it — no manual URL needed, or open the [Planable plugin in ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins?q=planable).
- **Custom connector (any MCP client):** add a custom connector with the URL https://mcp.planable.io/mcp and name it **Planable**.

Pick the connection method that fits your setup and follow the step-by-step tutorial below.
